# Thunderbird Account Hub D320328 recorded accessibility history

Recorded review history says the host owns `role=radio`, `aria-checked`, form value, keyboard selection, and roving tabindex. `#updateAccessibleName()` normalizes complete `this.textContent`, so any slotchange recomputes title, tags, and description rather than using only the last changed slot.
